orders_description: Work orders across all customers and engineers.
orders_new_description: Quote or schedule work for a customer.
orders_form_work_description: Who it's for, what needs doing and who does it.
orders_form_planning_description: Status, schedule and the engineer doing the work.
orders_invoiced_description: It's on an invoice that has been sent, with its amounts, so it can't be changed. If that invoice is voided, the order is completed again and can be changed.
orders_delete_description: The order and its material lines are removed permanently; the materials go back into stock.
orders_materials_labour_description: Prices as quoted when the order was created.
orders_history_empty_description: This is the first order for this unit.
orders_equipment_unregistered: New installation; the unit isn't registered yet.
orders_report_description: Recorded by the engineer on site.
orders_invoiced_cant_change: {number} is invoiced: it's on an invoice that has been sent, so it can't be changed
orders_invoiced_cant_delete: {number} is invoiced: it's on an invoice that has been sent, so it can't be deleted
orders_only_open_scheduled: Only open orders can be scheduled
orders_delete_referenced: Other records still refer to this order, such as an invoice, so it can't be deleted.
orders_bulk_assign_description: Invoiced orders keep their engineer. Only active engineers can be chosen.
orders_bulk_status_description: Their materials are taken from or returned to stock, as the new status says. Invoiced orders stay as they are.
orders_bulk_delete_description: The orders and their material lines are removed permanently; the materials go back into stock. Invoiced orders can't be deleted.
orders_units_none: None: a new installation or a survey
orders_units_other_customer: One of the units belongs to another customer
orders_units_too_many: An order can be about {max} units at most
orders_history_units_description: Other orders for any of these {count} units.
orders_history_empty_units_description: This is the first order for these units.
orders_not_awaiting_acceptance: Order {number} isn't awaiting acceptance any more.
orders_acceptance_awaiting: Reported by the customer: awaiting acceptance
orders_acceptance_reported_by: {name} reported it in the customer portal on {date}.
orders_acceptance_rejected: Rejected by {name} on {date}. The customer reads why:
orders_accept_description: It becomes a quote to plan. Choose an engineer and a day to plan it at once.
orders_accept_day_required: Choose a day to plan it for the engineer.
orders_reject_description: It's cancelled, and the customer reads your reason in their portal.
orders_types_description: Give the order types names of your own, or hide those you don't use from the order form. Orders that have a hidden type keep it.
orders_types_dialog_description: A name left empty is the standard one.
orders_types_field_hidden_description: Orders that have this type keep it, and it stays in the filters.
orders_type_hide_last: At least one type must stay in the order form
orders_type_hidden_refused: This type is hidden: choose another one
